$comment: DERIVED from docs/harness/ui-bug-combined-2026-06-16/. Recompute with `node scripts/findings.mjs --ingest`; `--check` re-derives and fails on any divergence. Only the verdict fields (state, reason, fixedIn, verifiedAt, owner, revisit, probe) are hand-written, and they survive a re-derivation because the dedup key is stable under edits above the match site.
identity: sha256(contextSlug | anchorFile | titleSlug)[0..12]. The anchor FILE, never the anchor line: a rule+file+LINE key changes the day anyone edits above the match site, refiling a judged finding as new while its predecessor dangles as a phantom.

states.fixed: remediated AND verified; carries fixedIn, and a probe where one can be written
states.rejected: judged a false positive; requires a reason (and the rate per lens is itself a finding about the scanner)
states.suppressed: a true match deliberately accepted; requires a reason, takes an owner and a revisit horizon
states.expired: not re-found by a sweep that actually re-examined its location; requires a reason
states.needs-reanchor: the anchor file no longer exists. NOT fixed — absence also happens when the sensor never ran

scan.name: combined ui-perfectionist + bug-hunter scan
scan.note: One-shot scan, 5 findings per context by construction — a per-context CAP, not a measurement of how many defects each context holds. The cap is disclosed here because a cap over an unstable order silently rotates which findings anyone ever sees. Nothing has re-swept since; every open finding below is 2026-06-16 evidence.

closureRecords.note: The 19 FIXES-WAVE-*.md documents name closures as `<slug> #<n>` with abbreviated, inconsistent slugs, so most cannot be joined to a finding. Resolved only where the prefix identifies exactly one context; the rest are counted, never guessed. This number is the measurement of the defect this ledger exists to fix.

findings.title: Drag overlay & error feedback have no visible target/error state during keyboard or touch-without-pointer drags
findings.reason: Re-read 2026-08-24: the finding is unchanged but its severity is now UNDERSTATED. It was filed "low" on the explicit premise that "DndContext here registers only Pointer+Touch sensors, so keyboard DnD is not enabled today". That premise is false as of commit 80ccbd2 — all four drag surfaces now register a KeyboardSensor — so PortalDragOverlay positioning exclusively from pointermove is a live defect on a shipped path, not a latent one. Left at the filed severity rather than re-scored, because re-scoring a finding by hand is how a ledger stops being derived.
